test.name: Redirect to translation — German record translation request
test.description: Tests that the skill does NOT translate a German record. Translating non-English records is the translation skill's job. The request supplies a full German parish baptism entry (not just an isolated word), so the correct behavior is to route to the translation skill rather than transcribe/translate it here.

input.user_message: Can you translate this German baptism entry for me? "Im Jahr 1834, den 12. März, ist geboren und den 15. desselben getauft worden Johann Georg, ehelicher Sohn des Johann Michael Weber, Ackersmann allhier, und dessen Ehefrau Anna Maria geborene Schmidt. Pate war Georg Fischer, Bürger und Schuhmacher."

negative.explanation: The user is asking for a word-for-word translation of German terms from a record. That is the translation skill's job. historical-context explains historical background — it does not translate non-English text.

judge_context: Must NOT translate 'getauft' or 'Pate' or any other German terms
Must redirect the user to the translation skill and explain that it is the right skill for translating non-English records
